blockers.quote: What if your money doubled every day?
blockers.why: Check #3 fails: the title promise arrives around 0:40, not 0:15, and by 0:30 neither the loss nor the central question is clear.
blockers.fix: Compress the performed opening to ten seconds, move this line before 0:15, then add by 0:30: “It will not stop. And if you cannot hit zero, Lotte pays.”

blockers.quote: > SCENE: Lotte picks the paper 1 up between two floury fingers and holds it to the lamp. Jonas leans in. You shake the phone. Blank. Then 0,01 again.
blockers.why: Check #15 fails: this shows money leaving the phone and regenerating immediately, a different power from the promised midnight doubling.
blockers.fix: Replace lines 20–38 with a short Day Two scene where the lock screen replays DAY 1 / 0,01 turning into DAY 2 / 0,02 as one coin tears into two; Lotte asks, “Wasn't that one?”, Jonas says, “Now it's two,” and no spendable paper leaves the phone.

blockers.quote: > SCENE: Lotte takes the sack. The board: 1,40 wiped to 2,10, to 3,00, to 4,20. The two pensioners from the corner read it through the glass and walk on.

blockers.fix: Replace the final sentence with: “Jonas reads it through the glass, counts the coins in his hand, and walks on.”

suggestions.quote: Day twenty-eight. One point three million. You buy the building. The bakery, the flats, the lot. Lotte never pays rent again.
suggestions.fix: Make the bank-to-purchase connection causal: “So you prove the money is yours. Day twenty-eight: you buy the building—the bakery, the flats, the lot—and Lotte never pays rent again.”

suggestions.quote: Mansa Musa's gifts kept gold cheap in Cairo for at least twelve years (c06). Your gifts do it to bread. Ask Jonas.
suggestions.fix: Land the fact directly on the person: “Mansa Musa's gifts kept gold cheap in Cairo for at least twelve years (c06). Your envelopes do the same thing to Jonas's breakfast.”

suggestions.quote: So, would you have erased it? Tell us in the comments. And if you'd have done the same, hit like and subscribe.
suggestions.fix: Restore both sides of the dilemma: “So—erase it now, or wait one more night? Tell us in the comments. Then like and subscribe.”

keep.quote: It isn't taken from anyone. Except it is. From everyone. A little. Every night.
A coin isn't a thing. It's Lotte, agreeing to bake tomorrow.
